reason: Diagnostic follow-up to v4. The input asks for exactly one building; its street, entrance and room are features rather than additional building sites. The existing 0.1.0 stage-A site budget is set to one so a street-as-site proposal is rejected at A and can use the existing bounded retry. The model, prompt, skills, wire format and per-call output ceiling remain v4-equivalent. This is a separate one-case diagnostic, not a reinterpretation of the earlier four-case batch.
scope: Existing 0.1.0 fixed A-F building-oriented pipeline, one single-storey building. This does not validate general natural scenes, editing or all four v4 cases.
sample_policy: Run this case once. Any started run counts, including API, schema, geometry, budget and export failures. Preserve v1-v4 results and do not rerun into or overwrite this output directory. If a fix needs another real attempt, register a new batch first.

success.machine: result.json succeeds, source geometry validates, WIR package round-trips, Unity GLB and Minecraft schematic are produced from the same revision, and exact offline replay reproduces the package and target hashes.
success.human: Record whether there is one single-storey timber house, an entrance facing and connected to a walkable street, and an interior room reachable from that street. File production alone is not evidence of actual target import or continuous walking.
success.report: Record first-attempt success, rejections by category, retries, wall time and provider-reported tokens. A single successful diagnostic is not evidence of batch or population reliability.

cases.prompt: 在一块32米见方的平坦区域内，沿一条可步行的街道建造一栋单层木屋。木屋需要一个面向街道的入口和一间能够从街道进入的室内房间。
